leadership_continuation.reason: Although mean forward excess was positive at several horizons, event-level positive rate and fold stability did not meet the predeclared gate. Current strong ranking alone must not create buy/Confirm/amount decisions.

active_migration_spread.regime_limitation: fold1 (2024-04-01..2024-12-31) was negative; fold2 and fold3 were positive. Use only as conditional opportunity-cost evidence when the old holding has independently weakened and the new candidate has independently passed the full buy chain. No mechanical rotation.

right_tail_holding.regime_limitation: 2024 fold was weak/negative at several medium horizons; 2025-2026 were materially stronger. The conclusion is not that new highs are automatic buy points; it is that new highs alone are poor reasons to cut a still-valid strong position.

decision_layer_effect: When an existing position independently weakens and a separate new opportunity independently qualifies, explicitly compare the opportunity cost of keeping the old capital versus reallocating it.
Protect the right tail of strong valid holdings; do not sell or reduce solely because price is at a new high.
Do not buy or add solely because an ETF ranks strong cross-sectionally.
